summary: Run summary is the report an agent leaves when a run finishes: a one-line summary, a few headline numbers, the files it changed with lines added and removed, and anything that still needs the person. Buttons at the bottom open the changes or undo them all.
use: At the end of an agent run, when people need to see at a glance what happened before they review the details.
When the run changed files and people should see which ones and by how much.
When the agent finished but left questions or checks that need a person.
When people should be able to undo a whole run in one click.
features: `stats` like files, steps, tokens or cost count up from zero one after another, with an optional `prefix`, `suffix` and number of `decimals`.
"What changed" lists each file in `changes` with its added and removed line counts.
"Needs you" lists each item in `needs` with an optional action button. Setting `busy` on the action shows a spinner, and the item's text crossfades when it changes.
"Open changes" calls `onOpenChanges`, and `onDetails` adds a menu button in the corner for the run's details.
"Undo all" switches the card to its undone look, changes the title to `undoneTitle` and turns the button into Redo. Control it with `undone` and `onUndoneChange`.
The rows come in one after another when the summary appears. It sits flat in a chat thread by default, and `bare={false}` gives it a card.
a11y: A "Needs you" action button sets `aria-busy` while it is busy.
The corner details button is labelled "More" and shows a "Run details" tooltip on hover or keyboard focus.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the stats jump straight to their values instead of counting up.

faq.q: Does Undo all revert the files?
faq.a: No. It changes the card's state and calls `onUndoneChange(true)`. Your code reverts the changes, and Redo calls it again with false.

faq.q: How do I show that a "Needs you" item is being handled?
faq.a: Set `busy: true` on its `action` while you work on it, then replace its `text`, and drop the action, once it is resolved. The new text crossfades in.

faq.q: Can I show a cost with two decimals?
faq.a: Yes. Pass a stat like `{ label: 'cost', value: 0.84, prefix: '$', decimals: 2 }`.
